answer: Every added key must outwork its predecessors combined. grove signs each candidate’s own judged-work tenure; harbor freezes it at admission, and atlas orders all keys clustered to a verified operator, starting each candidate only after its predecessor is admitted. The first key needs one epoch; each later key needs more than the frozen sum before it. Ten clones therefore cost 1,023 sequential judged epochs, the tenth 512; a first key costs one. Fresh wallets cannot reuse tenure or leave the cluster.
